_doc: Project-scoped Claude Code settings for embodimetry. See .claude/agents/ for the team. Hooks below: (1) auto-format Python files after Edit/Write, (2) print branch + uncommitted-files status on Stop. The push gate (make all) and generated-artifact write-block moved to declarations (.claude/verify-cmd, .claude/generated-paths) enforced by global ~/.claude/hooks.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && ruff check --fix --quiet "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null && { branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); dirty=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "[embodimetry] branch=$branch  uncommitted=$dirty"; } || true
